slides.texte_overlay:
Lessons every man needs
before a long relationship
Learn to communicate your needs. "I need an evening alone this week." Saying it calmly avoids silent frustration that builds up for months.
Learn to listen without defending yourself. When she shares something hard, hear it fully before explaining your side.
Learn to keep dating your partner. Surprises, plans, small gestures. Couples who keep making an effort stay close for years.
Learn to share chores fairly. Cooking, cleaning, planning. Taking your part without being asked is a deep form of respect.
Before: our evenings felt routine. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I always bring something new to talk about.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: our evenings felt routine. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I always bring something new to talk about.

slides.texte_overlay: Learn to give space. Her friends, her hobbies, her time alone. Healthy couples are two full lives, not one shrinking one.
Learn to repair after a fight. A hug, an apology, a laugh. How you make up matters more than how often you disagree.
